title: Limiting cases of a = g sin θ
caption: At θ = 0 the plane is flat and a = 0; at θ = 90° it is a free fall and a = g = 9.8 m s⁻²; in between a = g sin θ rises smoothly (4.9 m s⁻² at 30°). A formula that gave anything else at the ends would be wrong.
alt: Acceleration against incline angle from 0 to 90 degrees, rising from 0 to 9.8 metres per second squared.
description: θ = 0: a = g sin 0 = 0, no slope and no acceleration.
θ = 90°: a = g = 9.8 m s⁻², free fall.
